sources.title: Hermes 3 - NOUS RESEARCH
sources.snippet: Hermes 3 was created by fine-tuning Llama 3.1 8B, 70B and 405B, and training on a dataset of primarily synthetically generated responses. The model boasts comparable and superior performance to Llama 3.1 while unlocking deeper capabilities in reasoning and creativity.

sources.title: Hermes 3 — Nous Research Llama 3.1 Models (3 Models)
sources.snippet: Hermes 3 from Nous Research is a 3-model Llama 3.1 family (8B, 70B, 405B), tuned for instruction following and steerability. Compare specs and pricing.

sources.snippet: Overview Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-8B is a 8-billion-parameter generalist language model developed by NousResearch that serves as a compact, efficient alternative in the Hermes 3 lineup. Built on the Llama 3.1 foundation, this model incorporates advanced agentic capabilities, improved reasoning, multi-turn conversation coherence, and enhanced code generation compared to its predecessors.
